description: A high maintenance (telomerase-like) rate offsets end-replication loss, so telomeres are held above the senescence threshold and the culture keeps proliferating to the carrying capacity. The maintenance term is a phenomenological gain, not a kinetic model of telomerase. Precomputed example run of the Telomere Lab model with fixed seeds -- not patient data and not a prediction. Illustrative model behaviour only; see the Scientific scope page.

biological_age.formula_note: age_index = 100 * (1 - mean(normalized_survival, normalized_telomere_reserve, 1 - senescent_fraction)), computed at every recorded cycle from this simulation's own terminal-metric quantities (docs/MODEL.md §4); an extinct culture saturates at 100. This is an illustrative composite convenience number, not a validated biomarker or a measurement of biological age -- see docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md.

title: Telomerase-positive / immortalised-like culture
